name: Approve Business Management System Q3 awareness
product: Approve is a cloud business management system for Kuwaiti companies. It handles sales contracts, monthly installment schedules, legal case tracking for defaulted contracts, and HR records including residency and work permit expiry alerts. The whole interface works in English and Arabic with right-to-left layout.
audience: Owners and finance managers of small and mid-sized Kuwaiti trading and services companies who still track contracts and installments in Excel
tone: practical and confident, no marketing hype, short sentences
valueProps: installment schedules are generated automatically from the contract
contracts in litigation are tracked with their court receipts and recovered amounts
residency and work permit expiry alerts before the deadline
full Arabic and English interface with RTL layout
role-based access for owner, admin and staff
